river_graph: not constructed; optional separate transport ablation
scope: availability and feature construction only; no external prediction or calibration

inventory.selection_basis: DOC availability only; no prediction outcomes
inventory.provider_completeness: raw response structurally complete; provider totals not independently reconciled

daily_policy.series_selection: first matching _00060_00003 column in each RDB header; alternatives ignored
daily_policy.daily_qc: finite discharge with abs(discharge_cfs) <= 3000000; signed and zero retained
daily_policy.qualifiers: retained in inventory, not filtered; same finite-value policy as frozen monthly data
daily_policy.duplicate_policy: equal accepted station-day values collapse; conflicting accepted values exclude day
daily_policy.gap_policy: no filling; pairs require exactly consecutive days in the same calendar month
daily_policy.all_zero_flow: valid ratios are zero with validity flag one when coverage is sufficient
daily_policy.monthly_footprint: all eight features zero wherever frozen x_mask[:,:,1] is zero
daily_policy.time_scope: same calendar month only; retrospective current-month covariate
